policies.scope: Twelve actual necessary older printed5cost collectible candidate dependencies; zero Standard roots. TIME_040 source/exact past pool remain unsupported, known BT_510/CORE_BT_510 family omitted. No Wild-format deliverable.
policies.bodies: CorruptedHealbot Deathrattle heals captured enemy hero8; Taunt Applebaum Deathrattle heals own hero6; BombSquad actual Battlecry damages enemy minion5 and independent actual Deathrattle damages own hero5. Ordinary EFFECT healing and MINION_ABILITY damage reuse existing health rules, protection, death, source and terminal boundaries; accepted death effects do not require a living source.
policies.random: BombLobber captures all current enemy live minion references, native RequestChoice samples one original physical recipient automatically, then public live_minion checks that exact residence before native Damage4MINION_ABILITY. No source-specific random executor, empty RNG or reentry retarget.
policies.batch: Scorcher actual Battlecry submits one DamageBatch1 to all other active living minions on both boards, including untargetable/stealth but not dormant/inert objects. Dreadlord classified controller EndTurnSpec invokes a fresh named body to submit DamageBatch1 to current enemies; accepted body survives source death and native repeats/clocks stay independent.
policies.health: Hydra and BloodGuard consume actual positive final DAMAGE HealthResult targeting their original captured source ID; zero/prevented/Heal/unrelated packets do not trigger. Hydra submits own hero3 even after lethal source damage. Guard captures current original living friendly recipients for+1Attack, including itself only when actually living. No extra living_source cancellation for accepted external rewards.
policies.watcher: FloatingWatcher self+2/+2 requires actual HERO damage result controlled by its accepted player and result.active_player equal that player. Armor absorption counts native actual damage, healing or damage prevention does not. Self-only buff requires its original living board body and exact MinionReference.
policies.attack: FrozenCrusher uses shared completed_attack to connect original declaration/combat/terminal, checks its own source ID/card/epoch/order, then freezes its surviving original MinionReference. Defending, bare damage and stale same-ID new residence are not a completed original attack reward.
policies.death: Junkbot reads original minion_died.death_id and validates actual entity/controller against immutable DeathRecord. Friendly current-at-death Mech/ALL uses public has_any_tribe on frozen record, not mutable grave/current face. Self buff uses original living source; unknown relevant tribe explicitly fails.
policies.secrets: ChiefInspector submits existing RemoveSecret for each actual enemy secret in accepted order. Native secret area retirement/removed event is reused; no manual zone mutation or minion-death simulation.
policies.evidence: All13 complete original rows and26 strict bilingual primary faces retained without numeric/display normalization; eligibility candidates, internal behavior and official M0/M6 evidence remain separate.
policies.limits: M0 fixed CN patch/legal pool, M6 precise health/source/target/trigger/death/end/attack and secret-removal windows, exact past eligibility plus all actual reachable content remain open. No new player program, engine/effect or local restricted pool.
